title: System IA Cohesion + Options Coverage + Guided Setup Entry Points
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar places DHCP Server under Services and removes it from Network.
SSH remains under the System -> Options & Coverage flow.
Acceleration is available under System -> Options & Coverage.
System Options page exists and allows editing hostname/timezone/domain.
DNS server ownership remains in DNS Resolver flow (not duplicated in System Options).
System Options page provides clear setup-wizard entry points for WAN/LAN/firewall onboarding.
Firewall Zones guided setup is a top-right modal button intended for one-time use but re-runnable.
Firewall Policies page includes direct links to Network Wizard and Zone Wizard.
Service shortcuts open without the horizontal multi-service tab strip.
Runtime build/start validation passes and site remains reachable after deploy.
assumptions: Network Setup Wizard remains the primary initial bootstrap path for new users.
System Options saves should preserve existing system name-servers while DNS configuration is managed via DNS Resolver.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked on this host until OS dependencies are installed.

tasks.notes: Mapped Mark's IA request into concrete acceptance criteria for sidebar, system options, and wizard entry points.

Added System Options page, refined sidebar IA (including DHCP under Services and acceleration under Options), enabled single-service view mode, and ensured setup wizard entry points are visible in zones/policies/system.
Added regression tests for system config update operations and timezone validation.
Ran frontend typecheck/lint/build/runtime smoke; browser smoke remains blocked by missing host libs.
Restarted vm-ui and verified listeners/HTTP probes after deploy.
Next increment: DHCP UX behavior and firewall zones education/help page.
